notes: Version 2.3 corrects one step of the proof of the conditional flatness proposition: a decomposition of the open residual fibre stable under the admissible generators is not forbidden by Axiom A3 as stated. The Foundation non-factorisability lemma forbids it only under an additional sector reading of A3, not derived (Foundation version 2.6, Lemma 5.6), and the hypothesis H-res states that reading for the residual fibre. The proposition, its hypotheses and the results of the paper are unchanged.
